notes.title: Version 0.2.1 update
notes.content:
Hello all,

New content is in the works.
Fore more information see the live streams on YouTube.
https://youtube.com/live/VkHxYh4-aLs?feature=share

Added language support:
 - Spanish

New content:
- Added quick resources view:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345250/01c1c85349951507f24f25c67f9837ef978ba304.png[/img]
*Note, new resource is not in use, so its not going to accumulate, content for 0.3.X release
- Added system view:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345250/bb19e1208c04f01887ef52fd478188180fb3f658.png[/img]
*Note, for now not interactive buttons, intended for 0.3.X release.

Bug fix list:
- "Next planet" was showing in English while in Serbian Localisation.
- In an event Drones were showing as an option to be destroyed, while it was Droids that were in text of the event and were calculated as such, in Serbian Localisation

Noted issues that are not addressed at this time:
*Screen resolution is not editable at this time.
*Screen mode selection is behaving strangely.
*For now "When I enter settings while in the game (gear button in the top right), I cannot return to the game, the only possibility is to exit to the main menu." this is correct behavior for version 0.2.0.
These issues will be addressed in version 0.3.X

notes.title: Version 0.2.0 update
notes.content:
Hello all,

The localization section is live.

Supported languages:

- English
- Serbian(lat) 
- Serbian(cyr) * some issues as it's missing fonts at this time.
- Portugal (Brazil)
*Spanish is in the works for a new update (0.2.1)

How to use:
Option 1, quick select
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345250/c2aed12351c80b460316eab3e43fc535cfd0783d.png[/img]

Option 2, navigate to Settings / Accessibility[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345250/0cc430c3375872df49cf88e31cd24bbb9b7e6376.png[/img]

Noted issues that are not addressed at this time:
*Screen resolution is not editable at this time.
*Screen mode selection is behaving strangely.
*For now "When I enter settings while in the game (gear button in the top right), I cannot return to the game, the only possibility is to exit to the main menu." this is correct behavior for version 0.2.0.
These issues will be addressed in version 0.3.X

Version 0.3.X stream is set soon, so if you wish to see some live coding, do join.
https://youtube.com/live/SDuRJX85anQ

Once more, thank you all for your support, and hope to see 0.3.X live soon with tons of content.
